findings.pdf_says: The level box around DYNAMIC sits inside the inner brace: {RANDOM / [DYNAMIC]} with the box closing before the inner brace closes.
findings.why_it_matters: The closing level-box marker ║ is placed after the inner brace's closing ╯, so the box appears to enclose the brace rather than only DYNAMIC. The same format on page 438 renders it correctly as '║ <u>DYNAMIC</u> ║ ╯'. Syntax meaning is unchanged (DYNAMIC still a brace alternative), but the box-delimiter nesting is wrong.
